milestoneCases.title: Track Mixer and Resolve E2E qualification
milestoneCases.steps: On 48k isolated project set fader −6 dB in mixer, inspect Edit then Undo
milestoneCases.expected: Both show same value; decoded track PCM uses gain within specified float tolerance
milestoneCases.actual: Native −6 dB fader parity, one-step Undo and independent source-to-output stereo PCM.

milestoneCases.title: Track Mixer and Resolve E2E qualification
milestoneCases.steps: Drive −12 dB pre-send; pull channel fader from 0 to −∞
milestoneCases.expected: FX Return input remains constant; post-send becomes silent; no dry leak
milestoneCases.actual: Native −6 dB/−12 dB source/send and graph pre/post oracles passed. Full −∞ endpoint sequence not rerun.

milestoneCases.title: Track Mixer and Resolve E2E qualification
milestoneCases.steps: Parallel dry path + delay FX Return with declared PDC
milestoneCases.expected: Aligned impulse at expected output sample; unchanged under 1/32/61/257/512 blocks
milestoneCases.actual: Owned limiter supplies reported latency on the parallel Return. Exact 1/32/61/257/512 PCM tests passed.

milestoneCases.title: Track Mixer and Resolve E2E qualification
milestoneCases.steps: Route Group to Master, then attempt reciprocal send/route
milestoneCases.expected: Graph rejects cycle, Undo and saved routing unchanged
milestoneCases.actual: Reciprocal route/send rejection and retained bus after cancelled native deletion verified. Full Group Undo/reopen sequence remains open.

milestoneCases.title: Track Mixer and Resolve E2E qualification
milestoneCases.steps: Toggle two simultaneous hidden automation curves with one lane collapsed
milestoneCases.expected: Both affect playback and render; displayed curve remains Volume-first on expansion
milestoneCases.actual: Independent hidden send-enable and level scheduling passed. Full native multi-curve Touch workflow remains open.

milestoneCases.title: Track Mixer and Resolve E2E qualification
milestoneCases.steps: Export two identically named Group/Return stems and Master
milestoneCases.expected: Distinct deterministic paths; equal origin/tail; receipts verify hashes
milestoneCases.actual: Independent two-owner same-name batch plus Master shared alignment and verified file and receipt hashes.

milestoneCases.title: Track Mixer and Resolve E2E qualification
milestoneCases.steps: Place 5.1 Side then Rear at Resolve playhead
milestoneCases.expected: Exact named channel mapping and no overwrites; save/quit/reopen retains online items
milestoneCases.evidenceKind: External/manual or mixed; real acceptance required
milestoneCases.actual: Both Side and Rear masks and unchanged channel indices verified. Saved Resolve items reopened online.

milestoneCases.title: Track Mixer and Resolve E2E qualification
milestoneCases.steps: Place into locked/occupied active track, then safe override
milestoneCases.expected: First fails without edits, second enters requested unlocked track only
milestoneCases.actual: Receiver refused occupied A1 and locked A2 without changing timeline. Explicit A2 later placed at the requested frame.

milestoneCases.title: Track Mixer and Resolve E2E qualification
milestoneCases.steps: Physical Drag prepared file to Resolve pool
milestoneCases.expected: New item imported, placed, saved, reopened online; native start alone = Fail/Blocked
milestoneCases.evidenceKind: External/manual or mixed; real acceptance required
milestoneCases.actual: Physical drags imported the exact source and mixer stem. Resolve confirmed both timeline items and their persistence after both apps quit.

milestoneCases.title: Track Mixer and Resolve E2E qualification
milestoneCases.steps: Interrupt render at ENOSPC and helper death
milestoneCases.expected: Prior finalized output unchanged; no false Ready; recoverable diagnostic
milestoneCases.actual: Physical disk ENOSPC preserved saved design; helper interruption and durable output retained in audio_health. Mid-stem ENOSPC acceptance remains open.

milestoneCases.title: Track Mixer and Resolve E2E qualification
milestoneCases.steps: Saturate telemetry and submit fader updates
milestoneCases.expected: All accepted ordered commands applied or explicit timeout; no deadlock
milestoneCases.actual: Duplex busy-socket test and 472/472 sequential live edits acknowledged with zero reported underruns.
